title: WNBA PRA Repair V1 Step 3 — python -m proof alias repair R5 forward-port
root_cause: The production cert is launched with python -m, so the executing Step-3 cert is registered as __main__. The previous bridge searched only the package-qualified cert key in sys.modules, returned False, and never replaced the frozen Step-9 directly imported _wait_page alias.
patch: Resolve the package-qualified Step-3 cert first, then accept __main__ only when __spec__.name exactly matches the Step-3 cert module.
Regression-test the real python -m module topology and reject unrelated __main__ modules.
Keep the frozen Step-3 cert, frozen Step-9 cert, workflows, product runtime, routing, model, projection, probability, ranking, qualification, and sportsbook behavior unchanged.
